text:
maria: Quick heads-up — noticed a customer hit an odd double-charge when reconnecting a streaming session that had a toolcall mid-stream. Console showed a provisional token tally that included the full stream + toolcall, then a confirmed smaller total after reconciliation. We should discuss a fix.

alan: ouch. do you have a session id / logs we can attach?

maria: sess_9u4f7a2c. snippet from runtime: `stream resumed from offset 128, route fallback to model-b, toolcall executed`, then `ledger: provisional +425 tokens for sess_9u4f7a2c` and later `reconcile: -180 tokens confirmed`.

kevin: looks like the toolcall was executed before the prefix checkpoint persisted. fallback routed the remainder to a different path and the provisional ledger kept the original prefix captured by the first route. when reconnect happened we replayed suffix on fallback and both sides ended up claiming overlapping tokens.

sasha: can we refund those provisional diffs automatically? right now the console is opaque and customers are filing tickets.

alan: not automated today. provisional entries exist but refunds need ops intervention (and manual audit). that's not scalable for PLG.

kevin: proposal: 3 parts — (a) telemetry/ledger tagging: attach `session_id` + `inflight_toolcall=true` to provisional ledger entries; (b) atomic toolcall semantics: mark toolcalls as atomic in the ledger so retries/resumes don't double-count the toolcall tokens; (c) sampling traces: capture a small percentage of full streaming sessions (headers + routing decisions) to debug routing/kv races.

maria: +1. also console UX: surface provisional vs confirmed token counts per-session and show the reconciliation delta with a short reason. customers should be able to see "provisional (pending reconcile)" badges.

sasha: for (b) what does atomic toolcall look like in the API? maybe a header `X-Redwood-Toolcall-Atomic: 1` and ledger entries carry `atomic_toolcall_id` so merges are idempotent.

kevin: yeah — internal header proposal:
```
X-Redwood-Session: sess_9u4f7a2c
X-Redwood-Toolcall-Atomic: true
X-Redwood-Toolcall-Id: tool_32ab
```
Ledger pseudocode: when atomic_toolcall_id present, mark tokens as "tied" to that id and dedupe during reconcile if duplicates share id.

alan: operational additions: make routing sticky for sessions with in-flight toolcalls until checkpoint or short grace window. also emit metric `provisional_charge_ratio` and alert if > 1% per-customer-hour.

maria: sounds good. UX addition: show a timeline in the session pane: [provisional tally] -> [reconcile event with reason]. Add a small "request review/refund" button for finance ops.

ops-bot: deploy job queued: meter/fix-session-tagging — build #456 — ETA 02:00 UTC.

kevin: i'll start a ledger PR to add `atomic_toolcall_id` and session tags. will include migration plan for historical provisional entries (sampling reconciliation).

alan: i'll prototype the routing sticky change and add the metric. we should gate routing change with a canary and runaway protection.

sasha: i'll mock the console changes (two states: provisional vs confirmed) and add a small note about refunds/guardrails.

maria: action items: kevin -> ledger PR, alan -> routing + metric, sasha -> console mockups; i'll draft a short runbook for finance/ops and ping dylan for FYI. thanks all. :thumbsup:
